summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the strategic minerals and magnet chokepoint. The strongest direct exposures are not broad defense primes but companies with mine-to-oxide, oxide-to-metal/alloy, magnet, antimony, and heavy rare-earth qualification links. The list intentionally keeps MP Materials as a reference anchor, then emphasizes underfollowed or narrower public exposures: USA Rare Earth, Energy Fuels, and United States Antimony. No buy/sell view is implied. This pass expands the public-company universe around qualified non-Chinese strategic-mineral inputs, rare-earth separation, magnet capacity, graphite/anode material, and defense-stockpile supply. The strongest evidence points to a policy-created qualification bottleneck: compliant feedstock, oxide separation, magnet qualification, smelting purity, and customer/offtake certification may matter more than headline mining tonnage. The two-lane result keeps MP Materials as the obvious reference anchor, while the underfollowed lane highlights Energy Fuels, United States Antimony, and Nouveau Monde Graphite as smaller public names with plausible exposure to regulated critical-mineral supply constraints. Expanded the node around qualified non-Chinese strategic-mineral inputs rather than headline mining tonnage. The two-lane universe keeps MP Materials as the obvious U.S. rare-earth/magnet reference anchor, while the underfollowed lane emphasizes smaller public companies tied to separation, non-China feedstock, antimony processing, and defense-qualified future supply.
